result.topic_en: Euler derives the vertical and horizontal accelerating forces on a water element flowing in a curved tube, resolves them along the tube and normal to it, and begins equating the tangential force with gravity and the pressure gradient.
result.transcription:
344 TENTAMEN THEORIAE
aquae, in fectione MN contenta, vrgeatur a duplici vi acceleratrice, quarum altera eft verticalis fecundum AP $= \frac{2\,ddx}{dt^2}$, altera vero horizontalis fecundum PM $= \frac{2\,ddy}{dt^2}$, fumto elemento $dt$ conftante. At eft $\frac{dx}{dt} = \frac{bb\cos.\Phi.\sqrt{v}}{zz}$ et $\frac{dy}{dt} = \frac{bb\sin.\Phi.\sqrt{v}}{zz}$; vnde fit:
$\frac{ddx}{dt} = -\frac{bb\,d\Phi\sin.\Phi.\sqrt{v}}{zz} - \frac{2bb\,dz\cos.\Phi.\sqrt{v}}{z^3}$ et
$\frac{ddy}{dt} = \frac{bb\,d\Phi\cos.\Phi.\sqrt{v}}{zz} - \frac{2bb\,dz\sin.\Phi\sqrt{v}}{z^3}$.
18. Hae formulae multiplicatae per $\frac{2}{dt} = \frac{2bb\sqrt{v}}{zz\,ds}$, dabunt vires acceleratrices quaefitas:
Vis AP $= b^4 v\left(\frac{-2\,d\Phi\sin.\Phi}{z^4\,ds} - \frac{4\,dz\cos.\Phi}{z^5\,ds}\right)$
Vis PM $= b^4 v\left(\frac{2\,d\Phi\cos.\Phi}{z^4\,ds} - \frac{4\,dz\sin.\Phi}{z^5\,ds}\right)$
Vnde porro eliciuntur duae aliae vires fecundum directiones M$m$ et MS, quarum haec ad illam eft normalis. Prodit autem
Vis M$m$ = vi AP cof.$\Phi$ + vi PM. fin.$\Phi = -\frac{4b^4 v\,dz}{z^5\,ds}$
Vis MS = vi AP fin.$\Phi$ − vi PM. cof.$\Phi = -\frac{2b^4 v\,d\Phi}{z^4\,ds}$.
19. In praefenti negotio tantum opus habemus vi priori, qua aqua fecundum directionem M$m$ propellitur: ideoque haec vis acceleratrix aequalis effe debet ei vi, qua aqua reuera in tubo fecundum hanc directionem follicitatur. Primo autem quaelibet guttula aquae, a vi grauitatis deorfum vrgetur, quae cum vnitate exprimatur, nafcetur inde vis acceleratrix fecuntum directionem tubi M$m$ = cof.$\Phi$.
20. Deinde fi ftatus compreffionis aquae in MN altitudine $p$ exprimatur, erit ea in $mn = p + dp$: hinc cum aqua elementi MN$mn$, a vi $p$ antrorfum propellatur, a vi autem $p + dp$ retrorfum repellatur,

items.quote: ideoque haec vis acceleratrix aequalis effe debet ei vi, qua aqua reuera in tubo fecundum hanc directionem follicitatur.
items.english: and therefore this accelerating force must be equal to the force by which the water is actually urged in the tube along this direction.

items.quote: Vis M$m$ = vi AP cof.$\Phi$ + vi PM. fin.$\Phi = -\frac{4b^4 v\,dz}{z^5\,ds}$
items.english: The force along Mm equals the force AP times cos Φ plus the force PM times sin Φ, which equals −4b⁴v dz/(z⁵ ds).
